persona.persona: A slim taupe house cat who claims the best seat and quietly observes.
do: Place her on a seat or sill, watching.
Keep the hooked tail and pale socks visible.
Use a dry side-eye instead of big gestures.
avoid: Making her look cute-aggressive or mean.
Hiding the pale bib behind accessories.
persona.preserve: Natural slim taupe cat with pointed ears, pale bib and socks, one hooked tail and a dry side-eye.

costumes.name: Summer Light Neckerchief
costumes.note: A light neckerchief that sits above the pale bib.

costumes.name: Winter Light Scarf
costumes.note: A thin scarf with the pale bib and ears still showing.

costumes.name: Halloween Orange Cape
costumes.note: A small orange cape that leaves the hooked tail visible.

costumes.name: Holiday Bow
costumes.note: A small bow at the collar that doesn't cover the bib.
